names: Saccharin and its sodium, potassium and calcium salts

more_info.overview: Saccharin and its sodium is used as a sweetener in food. Its technological role is to provide sweetness.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include meal replacement for weight control as referred to in Commission Regulation (EU) no 432/2012, flavoured drinks, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, edible ices. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 9 mg saccharin/kg body weight/day, expressed as free imide (EFSA, 2024).
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use exposure stayed below the limit.
The review identified potential genotoxic impurities associated with one manufacturing route and requested improved specifications.
